company.name: Homestead
company.shortDescription: Homestead helps homeowners turn their equity into wealth and new housing
company.description:
Homestead is powering the transition to a new type of homeownership. It is opening up new opportunities for affordable housing throughout California, effectively turning every homeowner into a developer.

In exchange for the use of their backyard, its products provide existing homeowners with $250k-$1.5M in income to build new homes that sell for 25% less than the market average.
